related.title: E91／CHSH：關聯量與貝爾檢查
related.titleEn: E91/CHSH: correlations and a Bell check
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學相位錯誤預算0.02；10度通過、30度不足；若δ隨機須平均sin²而非把平均δ直接代入。 tf_phase_scan.csv、兩埠正規化與誤差分解 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.00759612 與變更 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching phase-error budget0.02:10 degrees passes and30 fails; for random delta average sin squared rather than substituting the mean phase. tf_phase_scan.csv, two-port normalization and error decomposition Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.00759612 and changed 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學點估計需S>2才符合違反條件；2.6通過、1.8不通過；正式結論仍需誤差界及明示漏洞假設。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching point estimate requiresS>2:2.6 passes and1.8 fails; a formal result still requires uncertainty bounds and loophole assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成固定相位殘差10度；擾動為30度，不加入背景或幅度不平衡。 名義式 sin(radians(10)/2)**2 = 0.00759612 wrong-port fraction；變更式 sin(radians(30)/2)**2 = 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用(1−cosδ)/2獨立驗算，兩輸出比例總和應1；δ=0與180度分別給0與1。

合成四關聯為0.65、0.65、0.65、−0.65；退化後0.45、0.45、0.45、−0.45。 名義式 0.65+0.65+0.65-(-0.65) = 2.6 CHSH S；變更式 0.45+0.45+0.45-(-0.45) = 1.8 CHSH S。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 從每設定同結果/異結果計數重算E=(同−異)/(同+異)；檢查每E介於−1和1且S不超過量子界2sqrt2。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic fixed phase residual10 degrees changed to30 degrees, excluding background and amplitude imbalance. Nominal sin(radians(10)/2)**2 = 0.00759612 wrong-port fraction; changed sin(radians(30)/2)**2 = 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently use(1−cos delta)/2; both output fractions must sum to one and0/180 degrees give0/1.

Synthetic correlations0.65,0.65,0.65,−0.65, degraded to0.45,0.45,0.45,−0.45. Nominal 0.65+0.65+0.65-(-0.65) = 2.6 CHSH S; changed 0.45+0.45+0.45-(-0.45) = 1.8 CHSH S. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: ReconstructE from same/different outcome counts; verify everyE is bounded by one andS does not exceed2sqrt2 for the intended quantum model.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IEEE 802.1Qbv：閘門窗與可用載荷
related.titleEn: IEEE 802.1Qbv: gate windows and usable payload
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學相位錯誤預算0.02；10度通過、30度不足；若δ隨機須平均sin²而非把平均δ直接代入。 tf_phase_scan.csv、兩埠正規化與誤差分解 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.00759612 與變更 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。

related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學每窗需求8000 bytes；20 µs保護通過、40 µs不足；仍需保留跨窗幀規則與同步誤差裕度。

related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成固定相位殘差10度；擾動為30度，不加入背景或幅度不平衡。 名義式 sin(radians(10)/2)**2 = 0.00759612 wrong-port fraction；變更式 sin(radians(30)/2)**2 = 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用(1−cosδ)/2獨立驗算，兩輸出比例總和應1；δ=0與180度分別給0與1。

合成1 Gbit/s鏈路、100 µs窗、20 µs保護帶；保護帶擾動為40 µs，忽略其他已另列封包開銷。 名義式 (100-20)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 10000 bytes/cycle；變更式 (100-40)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 7500 bytes/cycle。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 把待發8000 bytes換成64 µs序列化時間，加保護帶分別84與104 µs，獨立檢查是否落於100 µs窗。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic fixed phase residual10 degrees changed to30 degrees, excluding background and amplitude imbalance. Nominal sin(radians(10)/2)**2 = 0.00759612 wrong-port fraction; changed sin(radians(30)/2)**2 = 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently use(1−cos delta)/2; both output fractions must sum to one and0/180 degrees give0/1.

Synthetic1 Gbit/s link,100 microsecond window and20 guard; increase guard to40, with other packet overhead accounted separately. Nominal (100-20)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 10000 bytes/cycle; changed (100-40)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 7500 bytes/cycle. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Convert an8000-byte job to64 microseconds serialization; adding guards gives84 and104, independently checking the100 microsecond window.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
